title: Chapter 1357 - 28: Breaking Through The Time Loop
content:
Chapter 1357 - 28: Breaking Through The Time Loop

Chapter 1357: Chapter 28: Breaking Through the Time Loop

...

Outside the valley.

Lv Ju watched Lin Yuan walk out, immediately moving closer, "Your Majesty."

"I’m leaving first."

Lin Yuan glanced at him.

"What about the people inside?" Lv Ju asked in a low voice.

"Don’t worry, let them all go."

Lin Yuan said.

"Yes."

Lv Ju immediately bowed and said.

When he looked up again, he found that Lin Yuan had already vanished.

"Your Majesty..." Lv Ju composed himself, staring into the empty distance, feeling somewhat dazed.

Did he really just see the Taizu of the Greater Yan Dynasty?

...

Atop a mountain peak, where it was steep and rugged, even an Entering Dao Master would find it hard to reach.

But at this moment, a young man was sitting on a giant rock at the peak.

The young man looked downwards, his thoughts rather complex.

"That Da Feng emperor used all the Original Divine Gold, not to follow the Taizu’s will to forge nine cauldrons, but to make a coffin?" Lin Yuan pondered.

Over eighty years, he exerted the power of the entire world and roughly figured out what the Original Divine Gold was ultimately forged into.

No matter how the Da Feng emperor tried to hide it, even erasing all craftsmen who participated in the forging.

But once it’s done, traces remain, and with Lin Yuan’s ability to view past timelines, after spending some time, he finally uncovered everything.

The fact that the Da Feng emperor forged a coffin instead of the nine cauldrons left Lin Yuan speechless.

A coffin forged with a large amount of Original Divine Gold, once completely sealed, is almost impossible to open by external forces.

Even if thrown back into the Earth Fire Cave and melted by the scorching earth fire, due to the coffin’s size, it would take at least hundreds of years to melt halfway.

To fully melt it, it would take an estimated six to seven hundred years.

"Moreover, he also comprehended numerous Secret Techniques to conceal his aura and reduce spiritual and physical fluctuations, trying to comprehend the art of feigned death?"

Lin Yuan speculated deeply.

If that Da Feng emperor operated the art of feigned death and hid inside the coffin made entirely of Original Divine Gold, then placed the coffin somewhere...

Who in the world could kill him?

But...

Why would this Da Feng emperor do such a thing?

Using the art of feigned death to hide in the Original Divine Gold coffin, how is that different from true death?

"Rather cling to life in such a way, than be killed by me—it’s not just as simple as knowing in advance that I want to kill him."

Lin Yuan gently shook his head, "This Da Feng emperor, like me, has fallen into this time-loop world, but my trial is to kill him, while his trial is to survive?"

In eighty years, with the help of various clues and his observations, Lin Yuan finally reached this incredibly astonishing conclusion.

If the Da Feng emperor were a native of this time-loop world, he would certainly not behave this way. He could have negotiated with me, exchanging his life for the continuation of the Da Feng dynasty.

Instead of ending up like now, with the Da Feng dynasty perishing and the Da Feng emperor hiding in a coffin, clinging to life, akin to being dead.

"Is this the real test I’m facing?"

"Someone like me, from the outside world, who knows in advance that I will definitely be able to kill him?"

Lin Yuan also felt troubled. If he had known these things earlier, he would have infiltrated the imperial palace when he first traversed, establishing a connection with the Da Feng emperor beforehand.

That way, no matter where the opponent hid, he could know.

...

A month later.

On the eastern coast.

The East Sea is also known as the deep sea, called the Endless East Sea or the Endless deep sea.

Lin Yuan looked out with his hands behind his back.

For eighty years, he had traversed almost every corner of the land.

At each location, he would observe future timelines, attempting to conduct a comprehensive search of that position within that time line, including digging tens of thousands of miles underground and so on.

Now, on the continent beneath Lin Yuan’s feet, in billions of timelines he observed in the past eighty years, virtually every part has been turned over dozens of times, with no trace of the Original Divine Gold.

That is to say.

If the Da Feng emperor really hid in the Original Divine Gold coffin, the final location of the coffin certainly isn’t on the continent.

"Deep sea..."

Lin Yuan looked at the endless deep blue ocean.

Not to mention that he is very close to his life limit; in two months, Lin Yuan’s physical body would completely die of old age.

Even if he still had ample lifespan, trying to search the endless deep sea like he did on the continent would take thousands and thousands of years.

The area of the endless deep sea is a thousand times, ten thousand times that of the continent.

Not to mention the sea floor of the endless deep sea—the environment there is so harsh that Lin Yuan simply cannot approach it and would undoubtedly be crushed by the infinite sea pressure.

In this world, no matter how Lin Yuan cultivates, no matter how much he surpasses limits, the upper limit of the physical body has been fixed; Lin Yuan cannot break through the limit of life, nor can he break through the shackles of the physical body.

Until now, if Lin Yuan’s heart and brain were shattered, he would still die. However, relying on powerful spiritual power, he would die a bit later, but he would certainly die.

"Remarkable."

Lin Yuan admired from the bottom of his heart.

At this moment, he even felt some respect for that Da Feng emperor.

He left no opportunity for him.

"Even if I had infiltrated the imperial palace upon arrival, established a causal relationship, and knew where he sank into the deep sea, there would be little point."

Lin Yuan thought silently.

The seabed environment is too harsh; he simply has no means to retrieve it.

The other used the Original Divine Gold to resist the endless sea pressure, what would he rely on?

Even if he found the same amount of Original Divine Gold, once sealed inside, he could not come out; even if he could appear, after diving into the seabed, as soon as he dared to surface, he would be instantly crushed by the sea pressure.
